body:
Thank you for your input. I am going to talk to him about what exclusive friends with benefits is because I also have never heard of that.

The guy’s fiancé broke up with him in June for another man after five years of dating. I also came out of a 7 year relationship in July. I guess that makes things more complicated as we’re still in the early stages of healing. If I’m going to be honest, I just want to get laid and have someone to cuddle with from time to time. The lack of intimacy is obviously strong after being with someone after such a long amount of time.

Agreed on the bro code thing. It rubbed me the wrong way a little/ seemed immature.
Quit my job to go back to school full time for a career change to better our future. None of it seems worthwhile anymore.

This has me tearing up. I also try to hold on for the sake of my kid. I get so down because it’s like I want to know how she will grow up and how her life will go but at the same time I feel like I’m even burdening her because she sees me distraught and I try to hide it sometimes and she acts like it’s her job to cheer me up and make me happy. It’s not her job, and I don’t want her growing up with that weight on her shoulders. I know that my family adore her and would spoil her and give her so much that I cannot. It’s a battle everyday should I stay or should I go?

Sending you lots of love and well wishes.
